integrity: One claim, full analytic proof and independently runnable numerical/symbolic checks. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous three-habitat complete graph, particular initial distribution, exponential independent clocks, no immigration after total extinction. Analytic sharp threshold is not a field prediction. Earlier generalized-mixture literature is a historical-priority risk.
title: A sharp recolonization threshold for bathtub-shaped regional extinction hazard
